content.text: The app’s theme can be toggled independently of the operating-system theme, so CSS media queries alone would become stale after the in-app `D` shortcut. I’m tying the favicon to `next-themes`’ resolved theme and using the white mark for dark mode and the black mark for light mode.

The theme-aware implementation is in place. Lint passes for the touched code and both assets are valid PNGs; the repository-wide typecheck still stops on an unrelated existing error in `lib/live/checklist.ts`, so I’m doing a final diff check without modifying that separate issue.
